format: Each step: dir (host->device | device->host), endpoint (bulk_out=EP 0x03, bulk_in=EP 0x82, interrupt_in=EP 0x81, 16-byte packets), hex (exact bytes of one USB transfer), annotation. provenance: 'verhue-capture' = hex dump found in Verhue's sources (probably captured from the official editor), 'clavia-derived' = built from the Clavia v1.62 serializers, 'verhue-derived' = built from Verhue's builders, 'synthetic' = device reply invented to match the decoded layout (field values arbitrary but legal).
description: Per-slot session ('patch version') counters. Slot bubbles carry the slot session in byte 4; a mismatch makes the synth/editor discard the bubble.

steps.annotation: embedded message -- unsolicited 0x38 patch release: slot B now has session 5 (patch changed on synth, editor must re-read slot B)
embedded message -- unsolicited 0x1F performance release: new perf session 6 (whole performance re-sync)
extended announcement, len=19 -- Verhue-described compound form '1F PV {36 slot ver}x4' (Gen2 Mess:1614)
extended message body -- Verhue-described compound form '1F PV {36 slot ver}x4' (Gen2 Mess:1614)
